text:
DeployBot: initiating region-sequenced rollout v1.16.3 start=1750009999 plan=US->APAC-probe->EU gate windows=10m
Jules T: preflight quick: APAC warmpool / cache priming status?
Marco V: APAC warmpool 20 nodes, kv-cache primed for top 30 prefixes, thermal ok
Elena (SRE): EU is the choke; only 4 spare GPUs in eu-west, p99 drifted last night after test runs
Jules T: ok sequential then. start US 6% canary, observe 10m, then APAC probe 3% then EU contingent
DeployBot: US slice=6% -> canary dashboard https://deploy.internal/canary/1750009999
Infra-Alex: automated smoke kicked: chat, embeddings, reranker. tracing=on sample=0.5%
PM - Lina: pinged CS that US small canary rolling, no customer-facing changes yet
Oncall Bot: alert rules: cpu>88% 3m, queue>45 2m -> post to #eng-oncall and page if hit
Marco V: US smoke pass: embeddings median 1.05s, chat lat ok, no errors
Elena (SRE): US stable for 10m. scheduling APAC probe 3% now
DeployBot: APAC probe start slice=3% -> probe url https://deploy.internal/probe/1750009999
Infra-Alex: APAC probe priming continued, will keep kv-cache aggressive for probe
Jules T: APAC probe run 5m status?
Marco V: APAC probe 6m: p95 130ms, p99 205ms -> within probe thresholds
Elena (SRE): scheduling EU probe 4% with longer contexts and high-concurrency step
DeployBot: EU probe start slice=4% -> probe trace=0x1a2b3c
Jules T: EU probe step 2 showing higher queueing, watching p95/p99
Elena (SRE): EU probe p95 spiked to 360ms, p99 ~620ms; seeing backend "kv_fetch_delay=200ms" and queue depth jump
DeployBot: auto-rollback condition met -> EU slice=0% (rollback) trace=0x1a2b3c-rollback
Elena (SRE): recommending immediate pin of EU lanes to v1.16.2 until we identify cause (suggest lock 45m)
PM - Lina: updating release notes: "EU rollout paused; traffic pinned to v1.16.2 due to latency regression observed under high-concurrency contexts"
Jules T: agree pin EU. Notify partners and update change-window doc. Also add a note about staggered resumption plan
Infra-Alex: collecting perf dumps, kernel selection logs, quantization selection diffs. Uploading to ticket INC-1750, ETA 22m
Marco V: APAC probe holding at 3% for now. if clean at +10m we can ramp APAC to 6% then 12% sequentially
Elena (SRE): pin recorded: EU pinned_version=1.16.2 locked_until=1750012799 (approx 45m)
DeployBot: roll state: US=6% live, APAC=3% probe, EU=pinned->previous. Full rollout paused for EU. dashboard -> https://ops.internal/deploys/1750009999
Oncall Bot: will escalate to eng-runtime if new p95/p99 regressions observed
Jules T: next actions: SRE to triage queueing and kv delays, infra to compare runtime kernel/quantization between versions, PM to notify docs/CS. reconvene in 30m or earlier if new findings
PM - Lina: added customer-facing blurb and internal changelog line. scheduling 30m check-in
Elena (SRE): if root cause not found in 45m we'll open a postmortem and tag perf/runtime teams
Marco V: thanks team, paste any logs or traces here and in INC-1750. :thumbsup:
